stt-async-v5.description: Async v5 — diarized asynchronous transcription with token timestamps
stt-async-v5.pricingNotes: Soniox async speech-to-text is estimated at approximately $0.10/hour from its token-based public pricing, with speaker diarization, language identification, and smart formatting included. The reused timing estimate is provisional until Phase 5 benchmarking completes. Free plan usage, subscriptions, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: Soniox's Files API documents a maximum uploaded file size of 524288000 bytes. Async docs separately cap file duration at 300 minutes. The transcription API also accepts audio_url, but no explicit remote URL size cap is currently published.
